newsitem.title: USA: Aon acquires Hellebo & Partners, Norway.
newsitem.headline: Aon acquires Hellebo & Partners, Norway.

text.p: Aon Group Inc said Wednesday its subsidiary, Aon Norway AS, has acquired the insurance brokerage business of Hellebo & Partners AS.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

Aon of Norway offers insurance brokerage and consulting services to both Norwegian and international clients, and specializes in marine, property/casualty, life/pension, aviation, art and reinsurance brokerage services.

Hellebo, a Norwegian broker, specializes in oil, energy, and marine insurance. Hellebo's operations will be integrated with Aon Norway's operations. The combined company will be headquartered in Oslo.

"The merged operations of Hellebo and Aon Norway will result in one of the largest brokerage and consulting operations in Norway," said Dirk P.M. Verbeek, chairman of Aon Holdings bv, Rotterdam, and director of Aon Group. Verbeek is responsible for retail broking and consulting operations in Europe, Middle East, Asia and Australia/Pacific.
Aon Group is a subsidiary of Aon Corporation, a holding company that comprises a family of insurance brokerage consulting and insurance underwriting subsidiaries.
